0022600188.text: Golden State hosts Miami in the Warriors' ninth game of the 2026-27 season, as they sit at 5-3 on a five-game winning streak, while the Heat are 2-5 and coming off a loss. The Warriors are 2nd in the Pacific, one game back, and 8th in the West, and they are without Gui Santos (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and Golden State won their most recent meeting 135-112 in San Francisco on January 19, 2026, while the 2026-27 series has no games yet.
